    def __init__(self, seed=42):  # Default seed for testing
        self.seed = seed

        for i in range(63):
            self.state.append((3 * (self.state[i] ^ (self.state[i-1] >> 4)) + i+1) % 64)

        if self.index >= 64:

                val = y >> 1
